brief.ask: Create a brand identity for Kilnroom, the online shop in this folder.
brief.owner: Owner preferences: handmade and warm but not rustic or folksy; no pottery wheels, no vase or mug silhouettes, no flames. It must work on a shipping label, a tissue-paper sticker and Instagram. Web and social only; customers in Turkey and Europe.

claim.notes: Eleştirmen iki eskiz turunda da üç yönün hiçbirine seçim vermedi (kfold bir turda, opening ve chop iki turda reddedildi); kalite kapısına ulaşan konsept olmadığı için sonuçlandırma, dışa aktarma ve galeri yapılmadı.

concepts.title: Maker's Chop
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 fingerprint/target (security icon); s2 tally slashes or barcode in a badge; s3 water/wave icon; s4 bomb with fuse, garlic or a vase/pot (owner exclusion); s5 hypnosis spiral or cinnamon roll. The faceted seal outline is the one ownable thing, but every inner mark is a stock read (stock similarity 69-80%) and 16px shows only a dotted badge. Different move: make the irregular hand-cut outline itself the mark, with one asymmetric notch or one off-centre cut, no inner pictogram.

concepts.title: Folded K
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1-s3 a K built from rounded bars, i.e. generic K monogram with offset/split pieces; s4 K cut from a rounded square, app tile. All are the initial with a cut or step. Different move: leave the letter; build a non-letter mark (a pressed or fired form with a distinctive silhouette) and let the K live in the wordmark only.

concepts.title: The Opening
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 three bars, list/hamburger menu; s2 brick grid, dots at 16px, generic wall icon; s3 pie chart or Pac-Man, clock wedge; s4 target or nested UI frame. All struck: the product's own object (kiln shelves, bricks) drawn plainly or UI geometry. Try a different move: an opening shown by one distinctive silhouette (a cut-out or notch in a made object's edge) rather than a diagram of the kiln.
